welcome.intro: We'll help you prep for tech interviews with AI as your coach.
welcome.feature_questions: Generate technical questions tailored to your level.
welcome.feature_study: Review knowledge with a spaced repetition algorithm (SM-2).
welcome.feature_interview: Simulate real interviews with a conversational AI.
welcome.byok_note: The app uses your own Google Gemini API key. We don't charge you — you only pay Google for what you use.

api_key.intro: The app uses Gemini to generate questions and run interviews. Your key is encrypted and never leaves your account.
api_key.step2: Sign in with Google and click "Create API key".
api_key.step3: Copy the key (starts with "AIza…") and paste it below.
api_key.save_skipped: You can add the key later in Settings.

preferences.intro: Tell us how you'd rate yourself and how many questions you'd like per day.
preferences.difficulty_hint: You can change this anytime in Settings.

ready.intro: Your dashboard will show your streak and remind you when to come back for reviews.
ready.tip_study: Start with "Start study session" on the dashboard.
ready.tip_interview: Or fire up the interview simulator right away.
